text:
Type: bold striped knitted throw
Use: warmth on a sofa, armchair or bed, layering; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: fine knitted cotton
Colors: black, off-white
Shape: folded rectangle with wide even horizontal stripes in high contrast, smooth flat fine-gauge knit, simple finished edges, light and drapey
Feel: graphic, crisp, relaxed, cozy
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, black accents, monochrome prints; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms
